text:
morgan: New engineer hit two issues in onboarding samples: TS complaining no declaration file for 'redwood-inference' and Wrangler build failing with 'Cannot use require in a module'.
sean: Sounds like our package exports and types exposure changed recently. Do we have `types` in package.json?
morgan: Types live under ./types but package.json didn't have a top-level `types` field, and exports only exposed ./dist/esm as default.
pat: That explains it. TS won't find declarations unless `types` or an exports types condition exists. Also if consumers use require() they'll pick CJS or crash depending on the map.
ci-bot: ci:edge-sample build failed — packer error: SyntaxError: Unexpected token 'export' at dist/esm/index.mjs:1
sean: Proposal: add top-level "types": "./types/index.d.ts", add `types` conditions to exports for the root and runtime subpaths, and make `exports` explicit with `import` (esm) and `require`/`node` (cjs) entries plus a default fallback.
lee: Also add CI checks: run `tsc --noEmit` on js/ts samples and a wrangler pack step for edge samples on PRs. We should add a short README note: avoid deep imports, prefer public entrypoints.
morgan: I patched the node sample to use `import` so the new hire can continue. I'll open a PR with the package.json changes and CI job request. Thanks everyone.
